# SpillReady

> Online spill prevention and response training: OSHA spill prevention and response and air monitoring, with guides to spill kits and booms.

SpillReady (https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Spill Prevention & Response, Air Monitoring & Gas Detection training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Spill prevention and first response for oil and chemical handlers under OSHA and EPA SPCC rules. Enroll: https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Using gas detectors to decide when a spill area is safe to enter. Enroll: https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056

## Guides

- [SPCC training requirements: what 40 CFR 112.7(f) actually asks for](https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/guides/spcc-training-requirements): If your facility needs an SPCC plan, your oil-handling staff need training and an annual briefing. Here's what that means.
- [Choosing a spill kit: universal, oil-only or hazmat](https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/guides/choosing-a-spill-kit): The wrong absorbent can fail or even react with a spill. Here's how to pick, size and place your kits.
- [Absorbent vs containment booms: deploying a boom that holds](https://spill-response.hazwoperosha.us/guides/absorbent-vs-containment-booms): Booms look simple. Getting them to hold in current and wind takes the right type, angle and anchoring.
